spec.scope: Skill function damage — 7 sequential spear hits of 125.51% final ATK each, aimed at 'random enemies' (single boss ⇒ all 7 land on the boss). Must carry flavor:'sequential' so Sequential Attack Damage ▲ feeds it; NOT normal-attack-scoped.
spec.durationSemantics: Instantaneous volley per activation; no duration. Cadence is the kit-stated 'Recurring interval: 4 sec', dynamically shortened to 2s while skill2's CDR buff is live (skillCooldownReductionSec). First-fire phase (t=0 'start of battle' vs t=4) is a ⚑ convention.
spec.triggerIdentity: interval (sec:4). 'Activates at the start of battle' opens the recurring loop — it is not a one-shot battleStart volley.
spec.targetSet: enemy (boss). The ■ header's 'Affects self' is the mode-holder; Effect 1's own clause 'Affects random enemies' is the damage target.
spec.nearestWrongModel: A single aggregated 878.57% hit (losing sequential flavor + 7 gauge impacts), or an untagged flavor so the 85.17% Sequential buff is dead, or an interval frozen at 4s that ignores skill2's '▼ 2 sec' rider.
spec.distinguishingAssertion: onEvent damage: skill1-slot events arrive in volleys of 7 instances (or gaugeHits:7 on one instance) at ~4s spacing outside Penetrant Wish and ~2s spacing inside the 10s post-own-burst window; per-hit mult grows by exactly the sequentialDamagePct term (85.17 additive in Damage Up) on FBs where the Sequential buff applied and not otherwise.
spec.inertness: Her MG normal-attack damage per round must NOT move when Sequential Attack Damage ▲ is active (normals are not sequential-flavored).

spec.scope: Boss DEBUFF (team-wide benefit, taxonomy #4) + a kit-NAMED enemy status window. Needs BOTH a damageTakenPct 5.05 buff on the boss AND a targetStatus 'Open Wounds' (the name is read by skill2's 'all enemies in the Open Wounds state' gate).
spec.durationSemantics: 'continuous and cannot be removed' = permanent (durationSec ≥ fight length / absent). NOT a finite window, NOT round-count.
spec.triggerIdentity: On-HIT rider of the spear ('when landing a hit with a Dark Matter spear'), i.e. fires with each spear landing; no FB gate.
spec.targetSet: the target (enemy/boss) — explicitly NOT a self buff.
spec.nearestWrongModel: Stacking: 7 fresh stacks per 4s volley compounding damageTakenPct without bound (~315 stacks over 180s) — the kit has no 'stacks up to N' wording, so re-application REFRESHES one permanent instance. Second misread: encoding only the stat and omitting the named targetStatus, silently killing skill2's status gate.
spec.distinguishingAssertion: boss-held buffApply (casterIdx===null && targetIdx===null) with stat 'damageTakenPct', value 5.05, stacks 1; team totals in the back half of the fight scale by a CONSTANT ×1.0505 damage-taken term, not a growing one — assert late-fight per-hit mult equals early-fight per-hit mult.
spec.inertness: A second/seventh spear hit must NOT raise the boss's damage-taken term above one 5.05% instance.

spec.scope: Same Open Wounds payload (damageTakenPct 5.05 + targetStatus 'Open Wounds', permanent), applied as a blanket on burst cast.
spec.triggerIdentity: burstCast — 'Activates when using Burst Skill' is HER OWN burst, never fullBurstEnter (methodology #3).
spec.nearestWrongModel: fullBurstEnter keying (fires on ANY team FB — over-credits timing in multi-B3 comps), or treating it as an additional second damageTakenPct instance stacking with the spear-applied one.
spec.distinguishingAssertion: A boss-held damageTakenPct 5.05 buffApply coincides with her burstCast event frame; the total boss damage-taken term after her burst is still exactly one 5.05% instance (refresh, not stack).
spec.inertness: Damage totals barely move when this block is disabled (spears already applied Open Wounds by ~t≤4s) — the assertion is structural, not magnitude.

spec.scope: A named SELF mode (selfStatus 'Into the Fray: Penetrant Wish', 10s) opened on burst cast; both skill2 riders and both skill2 FB-enter branches key off being in/out of it.
spec.durationSemantics: durationSec 10 — wall-clock, refreshed only by her next burst cast (40s cd ⇒ no overlap).
spec.triggerIdentity: burstCast ('Activates when using Burst Skill. Affects self.') — fires ONLY on rotations where marian-queen herself bursts. burstCast ≠ fullBurstEnter is THE central trap of this kit.
spec.nearestWrongModel: fullBurstEnter keying: the mode (and its every-2-rounds core strikes + interval CDR) would run on EVERY team Full Burst, including rotations where the other B3 bursts — a large over-credit in any 2×B3 comp (controlComp includes helm B3).
spec.distinguishingAssertion: In controlComp (helm co-B3 present): on FB rotations where marian did NOT cast her burst, ZERO skill2 core-strike damage events and the spear interval stays 4s; on her own-burst rotations, the mode's riders run for exactly the 10s window.
spec.inertness: Teammate bursts must NOT open the mode.

spec.scope: flatDamage 14.06% final ATK with core:true — the text says 'core strike damage', so it receives the core bucket (coreAttackMultiplier 200) scaled by core rate; it is NOT a plain non-core proc. Gated on target being in Open Wounds (requiresTargetStatus 'Open Wounds') AND on the self mode (requiresSelfStatus).
spec.durationSemantics: Lives only inside the 10s Penetrant Wish window.
spec.triggerIdentity: hitCount count:2 — counts ROUNDS (MG hitsPerShot 1 ⇒ 1 per pull, so pull-vs-pellet is degenerate here). Counting scope: the wording 'Activates after performing 2 normal attacks' sits INSIDE the 10s mode, so accrual should be gated to the window (countScope:'gated' semantics) — out-of-window rounds must not pre-charge or spend the counter.
spec.targetSet: all enemies in the Open Wounds state (boss).
spec.nearestWrongModel: core:false (dropping the 'core strike' tag — roughly halves-plus this rider given the 200% core mult and coreDamagePct 24.64 co-active in the same window), or an ungated counter that accrues across the whole fight, or the whole rider keyed to fullBurstEnter so it fires in every FB.
spec.distinguishingAssertion: During her own-burst 10s window: one 14.06% damage event per 2 MG rounds fired, each event carrying the core-rate-scaled core term (mult includes core bucket AND the 24.64 coreDamagePct); zero such events during FBs she did not cast and zero outside the 10s window.
spec.inertness: Rounds fired OUTSIDE the window must not advance the counter (no core strike on the 1st in-window round).

spec.scope: skillCooldownReductionSec 2 on SELF — dynamically shortens skill1's interval timer 4s → 2s while active. A weapon/cadence-adjacent line that IS damage (it ~doubles spear volleys and Open Wounds refreshes inside the window).
spec.durationSemantics: 10s (the mode's Duration applies to both Effect lines).
spec.triggerIdentity: burstCast (rider of the Penetrant Wish block).
spec.nearestWrongModel: Permanent interval rewrite to 2s (over-credits ~2× spear damage all fight), or dropped as non-damage utility, or ▼2 read as 'interval = 2 sec from battle start'.
spec.distinguishingAssertion: Spear volley timestamps: ~2s apart only inside the 10s post-own-burst window (≈5 volleys), reverting to ~4s after expiry; a fight with her burst disabled shows uniform 4s spacing throughout.
spec.inertness: Interval outside the window must stay 4s; teammate FBs must not shorten it.

spec.kitLine: FB enter, NOT in state: Seq Dmg ▲85.17%
spec.scope: sequentialDamagePct 85.17 — ADDITIVE in the Damage Up bucket, feeding ONLY sequential-flavored damage (her Dark Matter spears). Emphatically NOT attackDamagePct and NOT a buff to MG normals.
spec.triggerIdentity: fullBurstEnter ('when entering Full Burst') + a NOT-in-Penetrant-Wish gate. The schema has no negated requiresSelfStatus; ownBurstGate:'notCast' is the faithful proxy (she is in the state at FB entry iff she cast this rotation — burstCast leads FB entry by the chain gap). The two FB-enter branches are MUTUALLY EXCLUSIVE per rotation.
spec.nearestWrongModel: Applying it on EVERY FB alongside the Core Damage branch (double-dipping both branches every rotation), or encoding as attackDamagePct / sequentialMultPct (wrong bucket: attackDamagePct boosts her whole MG output; sequentialMultPct is an undiluted true multiplier — both over-credit).
spec.distinguishingAssertion: On an FB entered via the OTHER B3's burst: buffApply stat 'sequentialDamagePct' value 85.17 on self, and spear hits inside that window carry it in their Damage-Up term; on her own-burst FBs this buffApply is ABSENT and coreDamagePct 24.64 appears instead — never both.
spec.inertness: MG normal rounds and the burst nuke must NOT move when this buff is live.

spec.kitLine: FB enter, IN state: Core Damage ▲24.64%
spec.scope: coreDamagePct 24.64 self — boosts core-bucket damage: her MG's core hits AND the 14.06% core strikes running in the same window.
spec.triggerIdentity: fullBurstEnter + IN-Penetrant-Wish gate (requiresSelfStatus, or ownBurstGate:'cast'). Fires at FB ENTRY (gets the FB-window context), not at burst cast.
spec.nearestWrongModel: Keying to burstCast directly (loses the FB-entry timing and fires even if the chain stalls), or applying every FB regardless of state, or scoping it to allies.
spec.distinguishingAssertion: buffApply stat 'coreDamagePct' value 24.64 targeting self occurs ONLY on FB entries of rotations marian herself burst; the 14.06% core strikes' mult inside that window includes the 24.64 term.
spec.inertness: FBs entered off the other B3's cast must show no coreDamagePct 24.64 application.

spec.scope: instantReload fraction 1 (self). Weapon-STATE line that IS damage (taxonomy #6): refills the 300-round belt and skips a 171-frame reload — extra rounds fired over the fight.
spec.nearestWrongModel: Dropped as QoL/'defensive' utility — shot-count under-credit; or modeled as a reload-SPEED buff.
spec.distinguishingAssertion: Reload events: a run with her burst shows measurably fewer/later reload events (belt snapped to 300 at cast) and a higher total round count than the same run with this effect stripped via withPatchedOverride.

spec.scope: MG wind-up (spin-up to max fire rate) acceleration — a weapon-state line that IS damage if the engine models MG ramp-up. The StatKey enum has no ramp-up key; fireRatePct is a different mechanic (sustained rate, not wind-up slope).
spec.nearestWrongModel: Proxying as fireRatePct +100 (doubles sustained MG cadence for 10s — a massive over-credit; ramp-up only trims the wind-up phase, and her burst just refilled the belt mid-spin so the wind-up may not even reset), or silently dropping it with no unmodeled record.
spec.distinguishingAssertion: If UNMODELED: the verbatim line appears in override.unmodeled.burst AND her per-round MG damage/cadence is IDENTICAL in the 10s post-burst window vs outside it. If the engine does model wind-up: pin the wind-up curve halving, not sustained rate.
spec.inertness: Sustained (post-wind-up) fire rate must NOT change.

spec.scope: atkPct 78.4 — scales her own ATK (self-target, so atkPct vs casterAtkPct is degenerate; atkPct is the literal encoding). Feeds everything ATK-scaled in the window: MG rounds, spears, 14.06% strikes, and the 1346.4% nuke if the nuke snapshots post-buff.
spec.nearestWrongModel: Ally-wide targeting, or conflation/merging with the separate Attack Damage ▲ 78.14 line into one stat (they live in different buckets: ATK base vs Damage Up — folding them under- or over-credits depending on dilution).
spec.distinguishingAssertion: buffApply stat 'atkPct' value 78.4, targetIdx === marian's own index, at her burst cast; no corresponding buffApply on any ally index.
spec.inertness: Ally damage must not move from this line.

spec.scope: attackDamagePct 78.14 — additive Damage Up bucket, self. Distinct line from (and diluting with) the 85.17 sequentialDamagePct when both are live; distinct bucket from the 78.4 atkPct.
spec.nearestWrongModel: Multiplying it with atkPct as one 78%-ish 'damage buff' twice, or routing to damageTakenPct, or granting to allies.
spec.distinguishingAssertion: buffApply stat 'attackDamagePct' value 78.14 on self at cast; a window hit's Damage-Up term shows 78.14 ADDING with any co-active Damage-Up entries (dilution), not multiplying.
spec.inertness: Ally damage unmoved; outside the 10s window her Damage-Up term drops back.

spec.scope: flatDamage atkPct 1346.4 in the burst slot, all enemies (boss). Burst-cast instant damage is FB-EXEMPT by timing (methodology #9: the cast lands before the FB window opens) ⇒ noFb; no core unless stated (not stated) ⇒ core:false; crits at caster rate per burst-damage convention. burstDesc:'allEnemies' tag is the structural match should an amp carrier ever join the comp.
spec.nearestWrongModel: Applying the +50% Full-Burst major to it (pre-FB landing — over-credit), or giving it core eligibility, or landing it AFTER the self-buffs so snapshot order silently differs from the engine's cast convention (order of same-cast buff-then-nuke is a convention worth pinning either way).
spec.distinguishingAssertion: The burst-slot damage event at her cast has fbMajorApplied === false (inFullBurst false / FB-exempt) and no core term; its mult decomposes to 1346.4% × her buff state at cast.
spec.inertness: It must not receive the +50% FB major even when the FB banner follows within the same rotation.

burst: Machine Gun Ramp-Up Speed ▲ 100% for 10 sec.

notes: Expected shared-prior misreads, in descending severity: (1) burstCast vs fullBurstEnter on the Penetrant Wish mode — the fixture's helm co-B3 makes this diverge every other rotation; a fullBurstEnter keying runs the every-2-rounds core strikes + 2s spear interval in FBs marian never cast. (2) The two FB-enter branches are state-exclusive — a model that applies BOTH (or always the Sequential one) every FB is wrong; since the schema lacks a negated requiresSelfStatus, ownBurstGate 'notCast'/'cast' is the expected faithful encoding and the driver must justify whichever they chose. (3) Sequential Attack Damage ▲85.17 feeds ONLY the spears (sequentialDamagePct, additive Damage Up) — encoding as attackDamagePct boosts her whole MG output, and sequentialMultPct would be an undiluted multiplier; both over-credit. (4) Open Wounds: no stack wording ⇒ ONE permanent refreshed damageTakenPct 5.05 instance, never 7-stacks-per-volley compounding; it must ALSO exist as targetStatus 'Open Wounds' or skill2's status gate is structurally dead. (5) 'core strike damage' on the 14.06% rider ⇒ core:true composing with coreDamagePct 24.64 in the same window — dropping core roughly halves the rider. (6) The 1346.4% nuke is FB-exempt (noFb) by the burst-cast-lands-pre-FB rule. ⚑ flags: MG cadence (rounds/s) sets the proc rate of the every-2-rounds strike and is datamine-unreliable (ALWAYS-⚑ #1) — the test should pin whatever cadence the engine uses rather than assert an absolute proc count; spear first-fire phase (t=0 vs t=4) is an interval convention ⚑; buff-before-nuke ordering within the burst cast is a convention to pin. MG Ramp-Up Speed has no StatKey — honest unmodeled entry beats a fireRatePct fudge; if the engine turns out to model MG wind-up, reclassify as FIX.
